title: The 1980s Music Quiz
subtitle: Three rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Hand-written starter pack. British chart references throughout.

rounds.title: Round One — The Eighties
rounds.blurb: Ten questions on the decade that taste forgot

questions.prompt: Which band released the 1985 album 'Brothers in Arms'?
questions.answerNote: The first album to sell a million copies on CD.

questions.prompt: Who had a UK number one in 1981 with 'Tainted Love'?
questions.answerNote: A cover of a 1964 Gloria Jones northern soul record.

questions.prompt: Which Wham! single was kept off the 1984 Christmas number one spot by Band Aid?
options: Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go
questions.answerNote: George Michael donated the royalties to the Band Aid appeal anyway.

questions.prompt: Which song did Queen open their Live Aid set with in 1985?
questions.answerNote: Twenty-one minutes routinely voted the greatest live set of all time.

questions.prompt: Kate Bush's 'Running Up That Hill' comes from which 1985 album?
questions.answerNote: It went back to number one in 2022, thirty-seven years later.

questions.prompt: Frankie Goes to Hollywood's 'Relax' was famously banned in 1984 by whom?
questions.answerNote: Radio 1's Mike Read pulled it off air mid-play. It went straight to number one.

questions.prompt: Which single gave Madonna her first UK number one, in 1985?
Duran Duran took their name from a character in which 1968 film?
questions.answerNote: Doctor Durand Durand, the villain of the piece.

questions.prompt: Which city were The Smiths formed in?
questions.answerNote: Morrissey and Marr met in Stretford in 1982.

questions.prompt: Which of these was NOT a UK number one single in the 1980s?
options: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
questions.answerNote: Cyndi Lauper stalled at number two in January 1984.
